summary: Not with backscatter alone (pre-registered test failed): a classifier on HH, HV and HH−HV trained on DSWx-HLS labels of 23 Aug reached a mean partial-water F1 of 0.26 on other dates (target ≥ 0.5) and its partial-water series gave r = 0.01 with Ladário (target ≥ 0.7). Next steps: texture, coherence (GUNW) and multi-date features.
